newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: TML SAYS IN TALKS ON SOWETAN NEWSPAPER.
newsitem.headline: TML SAYS IN TALKS ON SOWETAN NEWSPAPER.

text.p: South African publishing group Times Media Ltd (TML) said on Thursday that it is in talks with rival Independent Newspaper Holdings Ltd about buying its 42 percent slice of the Sowetan newspaper.
TML chief operating officer Lawrence Clark told Reuters the two groups were in the first stages of negotiating a sale.
"We have started discussions. It is very preliminary," he said.
The group already publishes Business Day, the Financial Mail and the Sunday Times. Clark said there was no clash of market share between its current publications and the Sowetan.
"There is a lot of synergy between the Sowetan and the rest of Times Media's publications," he said.
Clark said TML was keen to seal a deal, but added talks could take several months yet.
He declined to comment on a possible price-tag, but local media reports have estimated the stake could be worth about 100 million rand.
